URL: https://opinium.com/resource-center/voting-intention-28th-october-2026
Published 31 October 2026. Fieldwork 28-30 October 2026. 2,050 UK adults.
Labour 30% (nc), Reform UK 22% (nc), Conservatives 20% (nc), Lib Dems 10% (+1), Greens 8% (-2).
Net approval: Burnham +7, Badenoch +2, Davey -7, Healey -8, Farage -26, Polanski -32.
Priya Minhas, Opinium: "This isn't a Budget the public are overwhelmingly enthusiastic about, but by recent standards it has landed relatively well."
"The individual household measures have also gone down well, particularly those aimed at easing pressure on energy bills and supporting lower-income pensioners."
